chunks.title: Layer 1: PrimeNG Styled Mode
chunks.heading: … › 2. Design System & Theming › Layer 1: PrimeNG Styled Mode
chunks.text:
We use a **custom Aura-based preset** (`wfx-preset.ts`):
• Defines color palettes, spacing scale, border radii, shadows.
• Applied globally via `providePrimeNG({ theme: { preset: WFX_PRESET } })`.
chunks.locator: § … › 2. Design System & Theming › Layer 1: PrimeNG Styled Mode

chunks.title: Layer 2: Tailwind CSS
chunks.heading: … › 2. Design System & Theming › Layer 2: Tailwind CSS
chunks.text:
Tailwind is used **only** for layout and responsive design:
• We use `@apply` in SCSS (not inline classes in HTML).
• Example:
```scss .wfx-form-grid { @apply grid gap-4 grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3; } ```
chunks.locator: § … › 2. Design System & Theming › Layer 2: Tailwind CSS

chunks.title: Dark Mode
chunks.heading: … › 2. Design System & Theming › Dark Mode
chunks.text:
Controlled globally via a CSS class:
• **Light Mode**: No class on `<html>`.
• **Dark Mode**: `.wfx-dark` class on `<html>`.
• Service: `WfxThemeService` toggles the class.
